title: Typing useReducer: a State type and an action union

slides.say: Reducers get much safer with types. Every action you dispatch is checked.
Describe the state, then list every action as a union. Set count must carry a number value. Reset carries nothing.
Type the initial state and the reducer's arguments and return. Use reducer infers the rest from them.
Now a dispatch with a missing or misspelled field is caught right away.
